demo.title: Demonstration accounts
demo.description: Every account uses the password below. Accounts with two-factor authentication show their current code.

mfa.title: Two-factor authentication
mfa.description: Enter the 6-digit code shown by your authentication app.
mfa.backupDescription: Enter one of your backup codes. Each code works only once.

mfaSetup.title: Set up two-factor authentication
mfaSetup.intro: Your role requires a second factor. You need an authentication app on your phone (for example a TOTP app).
mfaSetup.scan: Scan this QR code with your authentication app.
mfaSetup.qrAlt: QR code to add Virtus Assets to your authentication app
mfaSetup.backupCodesHelp: Keep these codes in a safe place: each one lets you sign in once if you lose your phone. They will not be shown again.
mfaSetup.confirmStep: Enter the code shown by the app to finish.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.done: Your password has been changed. You can now sign in.
reset.missingToken: This link is incomplete. Request a new one.
